text:
old mentor I had was a fan of this [extremely non-academic] risk management term:

"driving with your dick hanging out the window"

this is when you are in a trade or investment that you have absolutely no business being in, or where your understanding of the bull/bear debate is in a different galaxy than the true market narrative

example off the top of my head would be something like "I'm long [semiconductor co] because it's trading at 5x earnings even though earnings just went up 800%...way too cheap, mispriced bet" etc

it might work

but from a process perspective, u are driving with your dick hanging out the window...just a matter of time before the mkt ensures u get clipped.
